Oh That's Why: the everyday stuff you never stopped to question, explained in under a minute.

Why are car tyres black? Why do fingers wrinkle in water? Why is there a tiny hole in a plane window? One short, friendly explainer every evening at 7 pm IST, with every fact checked against real sources.

Guess tomorrow's topic in the comments: the first 3 right answers get a shoutout in the next video.

Also on Instagram: @ohthatswhy.english
